title: ClinicalTrials.gov Recursion Pharmaceuticals study registry query
excerpt: NCT05552755 and NCT06678659 are recruiting; several earlier Recursion-sponsored studies are completed or terminated.
summary: The current public registry corroborates recruiting status for REC-4881 in FAP and REC-1245 in advanced cancer while showing a mixed historical development record. It does not provide commercial economics or validated approval probabilities.
